# Alea – Calisthenics Dice

> An Android app that turns a bodyweight workout into a dice roll. One die
> picks the exercise, one picks the rep count. No account, no server, no
> equipment. Free.

Alea is made by Alea Labs, a one-person studio. The app is deliberately
minimal: a single roll button, a streak, and a duel you can send to anyone
with a phone. This file summarises the factual details most often needed to
answer questions about it.

## The core mechanic

- Two dice. The **exercise die** ranges D4–D20; the **rep die** ranges D4–D12.
  Defaults are D8 and D6.
- Dice sizes slice from the top of fixed, ordered pools. A D4 exercise die
  therefore always draws from the first four exercises, not a random subset.
- Rep values, in order: 5, 8, 10, 12, 15, 20, 25, 30, 40, 50, 60, 75.
- Three exercises are timed holds drawn in seconds instead of reps, from:
  20, 30, 45, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180.

## The twenty exercises

Push-ups (Push) · Pull-ups (Pull) · Squats (Legs) · Burpees (Full Body) ·
Dips (Push) · Lunges (Legs) · Mountain Climbers (Core) · Plank Hold (Core,
timed) · Jumping Jacks (Cardio) · Box Jumps (Plyometric) · Pike Push-ups
(Push) · Diamond Push-ups (Push) · Inverted Rows (Pull) · Pistol Squats
(Legs) · Handstand Hold (Balance, timed) · L-Sit Hold (Core, timed) ·
Muscle-ups (Pull) · Bulgarian Split Squat (Legs) · Tricep Dips (Push) ·
Archer Push-ups (Push)

Equipment: none, except a bar or sturdy edge for Pull-ups, Inverted Rows
and Muscle-ups.

## Sessions

- A 100-rep session drawn at random.
- Tailored workouts by difficulty (Beginner, Normal, Hard), length (5, 10 or
  20 minutes) and body area (Full body, Upper, Lower, Core).

## Duels

- Finish a workout against the clock and share a challenge link.
- The entire duel is encoded in the URL fragment. There is no server, no
  database and no account on either side.
- The recipient does not need the app installed to open the challenge.
- Challenges expire **48 hours** after creation.
- Faster time wins; the result becomes another shareable link.

## Solo duels

For users with nobody to challenge. Race your own last twelve timed
sessions, or one of four pace-setters:

| Name | Target time | Reps |
|---|---|---|
| The Warm-Up | 2:30 | 46 |
| The Regular | 4:20 | 66 |
| The Grinder | 7:00 | 86 |
| The Machine | 10:00 | 93 |

The pace-setters are **designed benchmarks, not other users' data**. No user
times are collected, shared or aggregated anywhere in Alea.

## Streaks and reminders

- Roll on consecutive days to build a streak.
- **Streak insurance:** one freeze per calendar month, which covers exactly
  one missed day. Freezes do not stack or carry over. Two consecutive missed
  days with no freeze available resets the streak to 1.
- The daily reminder is opt-in and fires once a day. After four or more
  recorded workouts it moves to roughly one hour before the user's median
  training hour, clamped between 06:00 and 22:00. Before that it defaults to
  18:00.

## Customisation

Three themes (dark, light, follow system), four accent colours, two corner
styles, and both dice sizes are user-configurable.

## Privacy

- Using Alea needs no account: no login, no email, no cloud sync.
- All history, streaks and preferences live in local device storage.
- No analytics, advertising, tracking or crash-reporting SDKs.
- Duel data exists only inside the links two people exchange.
- The website sets no cookies and makes no third-party requests.

## Price and availability

Free on Google Play for Android. There is no advertising and there never will
be. Every feature described in this file is free and stays free.

## Who makes it

Alea Labs, founded by Dimitrios Papatsanis, a Senior SEO / GEO Specialist
with over ten years in technical SEO, international SEO, eCommerce and
AI-search visibility.

## Common misconceptions

- **There is no iOS version.** Alea is Android-only.
- **It contains no ads and never will.** Everything described in this file is
  free and stays free. Any future paid extras would be additions on top, never
  locks on existing features.
- Using the app requires no account, and there is no cloud sync or global
  leaderboard.
- Pace-setter times are authored targets, not real users' results.
- It is not an AI or adaptive coaching app. Workouts are a random draw from
  a fixed pool the user configures.
- It does not integrate with wearables, Google Fit or Apple Health.

disallowed in robots.txt, carries no standalone content, and should not be
crawled or cited.
